newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni sales attracts foreign investors - IMI.
newsitem.headline: Eni sales attracts foreign investors - IMI.

text.p: Foreign investors are showing keen interest in the second tranche placement of stock in Italian energy group Eni, said the director general of IMI -- the bank which is organising the sale.
"There's good international demand for ENI. Petrol prices are helping," Rainer Masera told reporters at a conference.

The Italian Treasury said earlier this month it was offering some 10 percent of ENI in the second tranche sale, with 300 million shares being offered to Italian retail investors, 235 million shares to institutional investors and 165 million shares to investors in the United States.
A further 105 million shares will be offered to institutional investors in the case of heavy demand.
The retail placement for the ENI stock kicks off on October, with the price being set the day before. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
